# Official collection parity fixtures

Seventeen reduced official target HTML captures, two observed rendered HTML
captures and two public disclosure PDFs from the 2026-10-06 assessment.
`sources.json` records URLs, capture dates, original raw hashes, fixture hashes,
retained financial baseline facts and six independently checked expectations.
HTML reduction removes navigation/assets, preserves all financial body/data/
component bindings and conditions, and retains unexecuted literal scripts.

The regression uses the ordinary filesystem snapshot and parse/chunk stores,
extraction artifact loader, current-run origin query contract, normalization,
validation and promotion gates. Network/provider/database writes are controlled.
This fixture does not authorize restoring historical facts or claim live Public
publication. Financial conditions and public-document language remain unchanged.
